claim: Target owners have a recurring enquiry or quote management problem
evidence_needed: Ten interviews with recent concrete examples
decision: Choose one cohort only if problem gate passes

claim: Owners will permit the minimum data access needed
decision: Use manual or narrower input if broad access is rejected

claim: Top-three action queue is clearer than a dashboard

evidence_needed: Measured baseline and assisted time including data entry
decision: Require useful improvement in at least three pilot businesses

claim: Follow-up coverage improves without harming conversation quality
evidence_needed: Eligible opportunity denominator and evidenced completion
decision: Do not count message volume as success

claim: Owners pay the stated price and renew
evidence_needed: Actual pilot payments and unpressured renewal
decision: Do not build on hypothetical willingness to pay

claim: Recurring support and provider cost allow sustainable margin
evidence_needed: Actual usage bills and support time
decision: Heavy-use cost scenarios currently fail proposed margin gate

evidence_needed: Longer outcome study with suitable comparison and attribution
decision: No revenue guarantee or causal claim

evidence_needed: Tenant security and concurrency tests against actual code
decision: Block public launch until tests pass
